carrier_semantics: CLI --min-carriers counts one carrier per source family/topology. Fremlin base/p/u are separate shape seeds but jointly one Fremlin carrier.
coverage_policy: global FAIL only with >=80% and >=20 valid carriers plus all predeclared priority topology variants
discovery_policy: absolute t<=1.2 early window; frozen spatial POD modes
fseries_variant_policy: retain all matched official Fremlin variants (safety cap 16 per topology/source family); variants are independent shape seeds but not independent provenance votes

katlas_translation.knots: explicit braid presentations become canonical closed-braid geometry; unsupported DT-only knots remain metadata-only
katlas_translation.links: KnotTheory PD rotation system becomes planar multi-component geometry with exact under/over z lift; Gauss component count cross-check required

library_selector: run_all.cmd --libraries=... --min-carriers=N [--kind=all|knots|links]; min-carriers counts distinct source families per topology, not files/variants
mesh_policy: Stage A segment-feedback tangential redistribution; nominal 2.0x RMS cap; provisional candidate low/high gain+cap gauge replay; Stage B no redistribution
name: SST_Intrinsic_Modal_Swirl_Clock_Blind_Falsifier_v0.2.2.6
native: C++17 pybind11 OpenMP indexed multi-component regularized Biot-Savart + stretch
parameterization_policy: per-component uniform arclength + cyclic phase; global rigid alignment; normal projection
progress_policy: blind per-candidate progress + 15 s heartbeat + elapsed time + approximate ETA; append-only outputs/<run>/progress.log
provenance_policy: all predeclared seed variants are tested; robustness votes are balanced by opaque source family (relaxed/fseries/ideal/ideal_links), require >=2 source families, >=67% candidate source-family fraction, source-family geometry coverage, matching modal channel, and <=30% representative-period spread
reference_topology_policy: only topologies present in relaxed catalog are included by default

source_formats.fseries: Fremlin 6-column ax bx ay by az bz Fourier coefficients
source_formats.ideal: Gilbert A0/2 + sum(A_n cos nt + B_n sin nt)
source_formats.ideal_links: Official Gilbert TL/STRING multi-component Fourier records; tolerant HL/LINK mirror support; indexed self+mutual Biot-Savart

stages.A: long-horizon geometry-only parameterization-invariant modal recurrence with mesh-gauge certification
stages.B: mesh-gauge-certified candidate-only material-core versus fixed-core delayed stretch causality
stages.P: blind seed-provenance robustness across selected source-family carriers, including Gilbert/Katlas links
